Judgment:

1. The plaintiff in the present suit is claiming recovery of Rs. 8,46,600/- with the averments that her daughter Preeti was married to defendant no. 1 Kamal Nawariya on 14.05.2014 according to Hindu Rites at Dousa, Rajasthan but the Sagai and Roka was performed at Shakurpur, Delhi in the house of plaintiff.

It is averred that at the time of roka, the plaintiff gave Rs. 5000/-
cash in the hand of the defendant no. 1, Rs. 20,000/- costly clothes and other articles as per the Hindu Rites and Customs.

It is averred that on the specific demand of the defendants at the time of engagement / lagan sagai, the plaintiff gave jewellery of gold and silver cost Rs. 41,000/- and cash Rs. 70,000/- along with silver coconut and clothes for the relatives and in this function, the plaintiff spent Rs. 1,76,780/- approximately.

It is averred that after the engagement/sagai the defendants had put one condition that they would solemnized the marriage in Dousa, Rajasthan to which plaintiff was having no choice but to accept and fulfill their demand.

It is averred that on the occasion of marriage on the specific demand of marriage, the plaintiff spent huge amount of Rs.
5,90,769/- in the marriage of her daughter.

It is averred that thereafter at the time of gauna (vidai)
the plaintiff spent Rs. 1,10,000/-.

It is averred that at the time of reception, the plaintiff gave Rs.
5000/- cash and Rs. 4000/- for vidai.

It is averred that at the time of first festival of Raksha Savitri vs Kamal Nawariya And Ors on 31 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135062620/
1 Bandhan and Karwa Chouth as per Hindu Customs, the plaintiff gave costly clothes, gold, silver jewellery for the in-laws amounting to Rs. 15000/-.
1.1

sentences.text: It is averred that after the marriage, the daughter of the plaintiff was taken by defendant no. 1 to his parental home at Tigri, Delhi where the marriage was consummated and on 07.03.2015, a girl child was born from the said wedlock.

It is averred that on 18.03.2015, father in law visited the house of plaintiff where plaintiff gave Rs. 12,000/- in cash to him, clothes for all the family members and gold and silver jewellery for the baby child.

1.2 It is averred that soon after the marriage, the daughter of the plaintiff was subjected to extreme physical as well as mental cruelty by defendants and other in laws for bringing lesser dowry articles and cash and that she was brutally and grievously injuries by the defendants and other in laws due to insufficient dowry and for not fulfilling their illegal demands and the situation got further aggravated when she gave birth to girl child.

It is averred that in the morning of 19.03.2015, the daughter of the plaintiff was brutally tortured by the defendants and other in laws and that defendants told the plaintiff on that day that she fell from stairs and was admitted to hospital where she succumbed to injuries on 26.03.2015.

It is averred that in this regard, an FIR bearing no.
406/2015, was lodged with PS Neb Sarai against the defendants.

It is averred that most of the bills have already been handed over to the defendants on their demand and a very few bills were in the possession of plaintiff which she has handed over to the IO of the criminal case which is pending in the Court under Section 304B/498A/406/34 IPC.
It is averred that the matter has been investigated and the dowry articles are in the possession of defendants.
Hence the suit.

2. All the defendants filed their joint written statement in which they admitted the facts of marriage of daughter of the plaintiff with defendant no. 1 but have denied the allegations of harassing and beating her.
It is averred that plaintiff used to play with law and she and her husband have lodged the case against defendants and their married daughter who is residing at Jaipur, Rajasthan.
It is averred that suit of the plaintiff is false, fabricated and concocted.
2.1 It is averred that no roka ceremony was performed of the marriage and it is denied that the plaintiff gave the amount and the articles as claimed.
It is further denied that plaintiff gave jewellery and cash amount and the clothes at the time of engagement as alleged.
It is submitted that no engagement/lagan ceremony was ever solemnized as alleged.

It is submitted that the defendants were very much aware even before the marriage that the financial condition of the family of the plaintiff is not so good as the only earning member of the family i.e. her husband was doing business of selling vegetable and earning Rs. 8000 to 9000/- per month, hence the marriage was solemnized in very simple manner without receiving any article/amount from any side.
It is averred that plaintiff has failed to mention the date of roka as well as the engagement.

2.2 It is denied by the defendants that they put any conditions about the place of engagement and that plaintiff belongs to Dousa, Rajasthan and brother of defendant no. 2 was also residing there and husband of the plaintiff requested to him to solemnize the marriage from Dousa and he informed the husband of the plaintiff that as he is not having house there and requested for performance of marriage at Delhi.

It is averred that husband of the plaintiff stated that as the marriage of other Savitri vs Kamal Nawariya And Ors on 31 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135062620/
2 daughter has been fixed on the same day and it will cause financial problem to them at two different places and that if the marriage is not solemnized at Dousa, they cannot perform the said marriage on same date.

sentences.text: It is averred that considering his request, defendant no. 2 agreed to solemnize the marriage in Dousa which was solemnized in the house of brother of defendant no. 2.

The defendants have denied the averments of the plaintiff about spending of money in the marriage and giving the gold and silver jewellery and the clothes and other articles as claimed by the plaintiff.
It is denied that the bills were handed over by the plaintiff to the investigating officer.

It is averred that the alleged bills to the IO are not actual bills but are just estimate of goods and even same are altered and forged and the husband of the plaintiff has admitted this fact during the cross examination in the criminal case.
The defendants have further denied the facts of giving the amount at the time of vidai, raksha bandhan, karwa chouth and at the time of birth of girl child.
It is averred that no complaint was even lodged by the plaintiff or her family members and the first false complaint was lodged after six days of unfortunate incident of the death of their daughter.
It is denied that plaintiff is entitled for recovery of the sum in the present suit.
3. In the replication filed to the written statement of the defendant, the plaintiff has reiterated and reaffirmed the averments made in the plaint.

4. On completion of the pleadings of the parties, following issues were framed by the Ld.
Predecessor of this Court on 02.04.2019:-
1.
Whether the plaintiff is entitled for the decree of recovery of suit amount with interest and costs, as prayed for ?
OPP 3. Relief.
5. The plaintiff in support of her case appeared in the witness box and also examined her relative Om Prakash Prewa.
The defendant no. 2 appeared in the witness box to rebut the claim of the plaintiff.
6. I have heard the submissions made by Ld. Counsels for parties and have perused the file.

My findings on the issues are as under:-
Issue no. 1 Whether the plaintiff is entitled for the decree of recovery of suit amount with interest and costs, as prayed for ? OPP 7.
It is the case of the plaintiff that marriage of her daughter was solemnized with defendant no. 1 who is the son of defendant no. 2 and 3.

It is claimed by the plaintiff that at the time of functions related to the marriage i.e. roka, engagement and the marriage, she gave cash amount, jewellery,
clothes and other articles to the defendants.
It is the further contention of the plaintiff that she gave cash, jewellery and clothes to defendant no. 2 when he visited her home after the birth of a baby girl to her daughter.
The defendants have denied the giving of the cash and the articles as claimed by the plaintiff.

The pleadings and the testimony of the plaintiff depicts that whatever cash or articles were given by her to the defendants at different occasions amounts gift to the relatives and the Savitri vs Kamal Nawariya And Ors on 31 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135062620/
3 dowry/istridhan.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The recipient of a gift is not bound to return the same on the asking of donor if some untoward incident occurs later on.
The dowry articles become the property of the bride which is to be dealt with in accordance with law of succession applicable to the parties.
As pleaded the marriage of daughter of the plaintiff was solemnized as per Hindu Rites, as such, the daughter of the plaintiff is subjected to Hindu Succession Act, 1956.
As per Section 15 and 16 of the Act, the daughter of the deceased Preeti is her legal heir who alone can claim dowry articles/istridhan pertaining to her mother.
The plaintiff is having no rights to recover the property pertaining to her daughter.
The issue is decided against the plaintiff accordingly.
Relief 8.
For the reasons discussed above, suit of the plaintiff is dismissed.
No orders as to costs.
Decree sheet be prepared.
